notes.flash_variant: Flash is a fully digital RuPay credit card issued only to existing physical Visa or Mastercard cardholders of Sparks, Ignite, Flare or Lumina. It shares the physical card's credit limit on a separate card account, cannot be used at POS, has joining and renewal fee nil, interest 3.5% a month (42% a year), forex 3.5%, fuel waiver 1% up to INR 150 per cycle on INR 500-2,500, no accelerated rewards, and earns 2 points per INR 200 (MITC, KFS, Product Usage Guide). It is an add-on account of a physical card, not a standalone product; not drafted.
